commit_message: Fix Managed Local WSL llama-server startup
pr_title: Fix Managed Local WSL llama-server startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- keep the managed WSL launch shell alive for a short grace period before returning the llama-server PID
- require the background process to survive the grace period and surface the WSL log tail on immediate startup failure
- report the actual distro-internal WSL log path instead of the Windows state-root path
- add regression coverage for launch ordering and environment-specific log paths

## Scope

This is limited to Managed Local AI WSL process startup and diagnostics. It does not change model integrity policy, GPU-layer selection, conversation error projection, or benchmark campaign routing.
